confessions: RESTATEMENT: Financial statements for 2018, 2017, 2016 restated due to misstatements in non-operating foreign exchange gains and losses. Intra-company transactions undertaken solely to generate FX gains had occurred for at least ten years. Quantified impact: income reduced by $35M (H1 2019), $78M (FY2018), $115M (FY2017).

MATERIAL WEAKNESS: Internal control over financial reporting material weakness identified as of Dec 31, 2018, continuing through Dec 31, 2019. Disclosure controls and procedures not effective throughout 2019.
REGULATORY ACTION: SEC investigation -- company voluntarily advised SEC staff of internal investigation into intra-company FX transactions and is cooperating with SEC staff.
